mask_contract.species_survives: every frozen graph edge has at least one cross-locality sequence pair with jointly canonical columns >= ceil(0.50 * frozen alignment length)

exact_survivor_design.roles: inherit original train/eval role for each surviving species
exact_survivor_design.geographic_support: recompute unchanged 500-km target coverage >=0.50 using surviving training species only; minimum five sources
exact_survivor_design.predictor: recompute Jaccard residualization and nuisance kernels under qualification rule v0.3 on exact survivors
exact_survivor_design.alignment: recompute the same deterministic response-blind nearest-edge alignment on retained target-source pairs

if_pass: Freeze exact survivor design and run formal v0.3 synthetic qualification before nucleotide identity.
